links.comparator_used: 3D-UNet pretrained on an international dataset, before HITL refinement with local data
links.outcome: Dice Similarity Coefficient for normal lung parenchyma and COVID-19 pneumonia segmentation
links.effect: DSC improved by 0.2 (normal lung parenchyma) and 0.5 (COVID-19 pneumonia); after three HITL cycles DSC was >0.96 for lung and >0.81 for COVID-19 pneumonia
links.tradeoff: Needed manual delineation by seven teams of interns, residents and radiologists, with repeated retraining cycles until the quality criteria were met
links.quote: The HITL strategy improved the DSC by 0.2 and 0.5 for the normal lung parenchyma and COVID-19 pneumonia segmentation, respectively.

design_hint: human-in-the-loop annotation and local retraining of segmentation model
